text: Scholarship Policy According to the strategy cooperation agreement between SICAS and University of Jinan, the students who get admission in this major through SICAS only have to pay CNY18,000/Year instead of CNY 28,000 /Year from the second year and the third year. The first year is not included. The scholarship will directly to reduce the tuition, not cash. Special Scholarship for SICAS International Students in University of Jinan (click to apply)
